subject: Social Media
title: Attention Inequality
description: A micro-lesson that makes Attention Inequality usable.

hook.text: A celebrity tweet gets 10 million views. A scientist's thread gets 200. Attention doesn't distribute evenly.

buildup.text: The internet promised equal access. Anyone could publish. But algorithms decide who gets seen.

discovery.text: Attention follows power laws. The top 1% of creators get 90% of views. The rest shout into the void.

twist.text: This mirrors income inequality. Attention-rich people attract more attention. It compounds like wealth.

climax.text: Governments tax money, not attention. There's no redistribution. The attention-poor stay invisible.

punchline.text: Online, visibility is the new privilege.

quiz.question: How does attention distribute online?
options: Following power laws favoring the top
